avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer decreases dasatinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with dasatinib

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit platelet aggregation, increasing bleeding risk when combined with dasatinib-induced thrombocytopenia

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction and antiplatelet effects compound dasatinib's hematologic toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue high-dose supplementation; monitor CBC closely

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4 and increase dasatinib levels; mild antiplatelet effects
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for dasatinib toxicity symptoms and bleeding

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet activity may additively increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor closely; acceptable in culinary amounts

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects may compound thrombocytopenia risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor CBC; limit supplementation to recommended dietary allowance

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases dasatinib bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; no grapefruit products during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase dasatinib absorption; administration with food is acceptable but timing should be consistent
caution_foods.action: Take dasatinib consistently with or without food; avoid variable meal patterns

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction with excessive consumption
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary consumption acceptable; avoid excessive supplementation of broccoli extracts

monitoring_notes: Monitor complete blood count regularly for dasatinib-related thrombocytopenia and bleeding complications. Counsel patients on strict CYP3A4 interaction avoidance and consistent dosing schedules relative to food intake.
